A LITTLE CHANGE IN PERSPECTIVE

Fictional stories, created to illustrate the Pello experience.

THE LITTLE THINGS YOU’RE WONDERING

A clear answer
goes a long way.

What is Pello?

Pello is a fictional personal finance app concept. This page lets you try a sample balance planner and explore a calmer way to organize money. It does not connect to real accounts or offer financial services.

Does trying the planner move real money?

No. The planner uses a sample balance of $2,400. You can try different plans and move the goal slider as much as you like. All amounts are illustrative.

Can I change my mind about a goal?

Of course. Choose another plan or adjust the weekend amount. The everyday allocation updates to keep the complete sample balance accounted for.

Is there a fee or an app to download?

This is a free interactive preview. There is no paid subscription, real app download or payment step on this concept page.

What happens when I leave my email?

You will see a local demonstration of a welcome confirmation. Your email is not sent to a server, added to a list or stored after leaving the page.

Privacy

Pello is a fictional interactive template. The sample planner runs in your browser. The welcome form shows a local confirmation and does not send your email, connect to accounts or store personal data. No analytics or advertising trackers are included in this template.

Terms

This is a creative product demonstration, not a bank, financial service or financial advice. All balances, stories and plans are fictional examples. No real money moves, no account is opened, and no subscription or payment is created.
